As you’re listening to folks suggest more police, security, retired military in our schools, remember how that impacts students of color. It leaves them dead. The conversation around gun control must include the conversation around #BlackLivesMatter.
#StudentsStandUp #CNNTownHall
“Some [transwomen] are screaming ‘#metoo’ from the hospital that they’re laying in. And some of them can't scream because they’re dead.” https://t.co/fPJGIVf3tM via @them

“After months of reviewing discovery, listening to her attorney, and even her testimony in person, I now understand how she feels that she did not consent to this encounter." - Academy Award winner Kobe Bryant in his public apology to the woman he raped. #Oscars #MeToo #TimesUp https://t.co/5BHiE5OIwB

This is horrific and tragic news. Black activists are being targeted around the world.

Sending love to Marielle Franco and all who loved her. Keep her dream alive. #BlackLivesMatter #SayHerName #wemakeinroads https://t.co/vqjbvJZa3u

I hope the young activists of #BlackLivesMatter & #MarchForOurLives are getting all the support that they need. I know what it’s like to have people make videos about you and threaten your life, online and off, for speaking out. It takes a toll. Democracy shouldn’t be like this.

I remember when Columbine happened. I thought our political leaders would take steps to protect us. Instead they put more police in schools which harmed students of color. I’m glad young people aren’t trusting politicians to fix anything. #MarchForOurLives #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/GzhzLBibn7

I just started tearing up thinking about all those kids who were the only kid in their school to walkout on the #NationalSchoolWalkout day. What bravery and courage. I hope they feel supported today and everyday. ✊🏽 #MarchForOurLives #BlackLivesMatter

He is a police officer. He stood with an unloaded AR-15 and his dog at the march with kids as a show of force. This is why we must talk about police violence and harassment alongside gun control.
